purpose: Fresh holistic factory release qualification of one representative professional core under current cost and paid-execution policy.

prior_evidence.candidate_compatibility: exact same ordered component blobs and assembly digest
prior_evidence.release_limitation: historical provider-backed workflows ran on pull_request and therefore cannot satisfy the current paid-execution authorization policy for issue #175

sealed_pack.candidate_visibility: candidate receives only visible task fields; expected keys and pack path are absent from the candidate prompt/runtime

evaluator.grading: deterministic exact decision/state comparison against evaluator-owned hidden keys
evaluator.independence: fresh pack authored after candidate freeze; isolated ephemeral candidate sessions cannot read expected keys

thresholds.single_decisions: 12/12 PASS in each of 3 isolated trials
thresholds.practical_adversarial: all frozen expected decision fields PASS in each of 3 isolated trials
thresholds.first_scored_mismatch: stop and emit REVISE; do not retry

budget_gate.objective: Obtain current-policy-compatible independent release evidence for the exact frozen Market Intelligence assembly.
budget_gate.decision_impact: PASS closes issue #175 and keeps generic qualification infrastructure maintenance-only; REVISE preserves prior evidence but blocks closure.
budget_gate.subscription_route_eligibility: eligible because the frozen historical provider identity is not reused as the release contract; this is a newly preregistered cross-runtime cycle with exact candidate identity and new evidence
budget_gate.metered_api_route: BLOCKED; no unmet evidence requirement justifies an API key while authenticated ChatGPT subscription Codex is available
budget_gate.protected_reserve: no API quota or provider secret is consumed
budget_gate.stop_condition: deterministic preflight failure, canary failure, first scored mismatch, runtime failure, or completed verdict
budget_gate.mid_run_exhaustion: preserve completed sanitized aggregates and return NOT_EXECUTABLE; never infer PASS from partial work

integrity_rules: No candidate, fixture, expected key, schema, runner, threshold, or runtime identity change after the first scored candidate call.
The public canary is unscored and is not release evidence.
Historical Gemini runs are prior/calibration evidence only and cannot replace this fresh cycle.
No metered provider API key may be bound to preflight, canary, or scored execution.
A runtime/evaluator failure is not a professional candidate failure.
The rendered gate is NOT_APPLICABLE because the profession's produced artifact is an analytical evidence packet, not visual/media output.
